interpretation.ratio_floor_reporting: Phase 0A reports the number and locations of slot-years where slot n_eff exceeds cell n_eff and the no-credit floor is applied.
interpretation.spacing_denominator: The spacing proxy is expressed relative to the parent V10 pre-bridge bucket mean, matching later S3 bucket-relative values.
interpretation.this_gate_is_necessary_not_sufficient: Passing only authorizes Phase 1 outcome opening if every other B52 source/governance gate also passes. Later S2-S5 and the forward holdout remain binding.
interpretation.why_slot_halfwidth_gate: Exact-slot V1 is not allowed to manufacture highly unstable point precision. A 30% relative 95% half-width is the primary target; 40% is the hard ceiling.
interpretation.why_spacing_gate: The incremental information over V10 is within-bucket spacing. The first-versus-last slot spacing uncertainty is therefore separately bounded.
interpretation.why_variance_ratio: Under an equal-class/common-within-class-variance approximation, class-mean variance scales with sum_y(1/n_eff_y), so exact-slot-to-cell inflation uses the ratio of inverse-n_eff sums.
interpretation.why_zero_correlation: Adjacent slot errors share draft-class and rookie structure and are likely positively correlated. Assuming zero correlation is conservative because it does not claim that covariance reduces spacing uncertainty.

precision_model.bucket_spacing_relative_95_halfwidth: sqrt(first_slot_halfwidth^2 + last_slot_halfwidth^2), with both slot half-widths expressed relative to the same parent V10 pre-bridge bucket mean; zero first/last error correlation is used.

monte_carlo.purpose: Audit the analytic half-width calculation; the pass/fail gate uses the analytic value so Monte Carlo randomness cannot flip the decision.

precision_model.principle: Use V10 bucket-level historical uncertainty as the base variance scale and inflate it only by the loss of independent rookie-cluster information when moving from the four-slot cell to an exact slot.
precision_model.slot_gt_cell_neff_rule: slot_cluster_kish_neff > cell_cluster_kish_neff is valid and must not raise. For precision only, use min(slot n_eff,cell n_eff) and record each no-credit floor event.
precision_model.slot_information_inflation: sqrt(max(1.0,R_s)); with s*_y=min(s_y,c_y), R_s is already >=1.
precision_model.variance_ratio_definition: For slot s and draft class y, let s_y be slot rookie-cluster Kish n_eff and c_y the parent-cell rookie-cluster Kish n_eff. Define s*_y=min(s_y,c_y) so a slot never receives favorable precision credit for having n_eff greater than its parent cell. Then R_s=sum_y(1/s*_y)/sum_y(1/c_y).

purpose: Freeze the outcome-blind precision algorithm and pass criterion required by B52 before any Phase 0A occurrence corpus is materialized or read.

support_summary_contract.slot_gt_cell_neff_precision_treatment: Allow it; the precision calculation uses s*=min(s,c) so there is no favorable credit.
support_summary_contract.weighting: Within each year/cell, begin from the frozen V10 occurrence weights. Aggregate occurrence mass by stable rookie identity before calculating Kish n_eff. For slot n_eff, aggregate only occurrences at that slot; for cell n_eff, aggregate all occurrences in the cell.

v10_reference_uncertainty.definition: Frozen relative 95% half-widths from V10's historical class-balanced core uncertainty. These are aggregate bucket uncertainty measures, not exact-slot values and not market residuals.
